english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a visitor or guest who is gladly received or for something people are happy to accept.

examples.english: Your warm hospitality made me feel very welcome.
examples.traditional: 你哋嘅熱情招待令我覺得好受歡迎。
examples.jyutping: nei5 dei6 ge3 jit6 cing4 ziu1 doi6 ling6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when many people like, admire, or enjoy someone or something.

examples.english: This cha chaan teng is very popular; it’s packed every day.
examples.traditional: 呢間茶記好受歡迎，成日都坐滿人。
examples.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4 seng4 jat6 dou1 co5 mun5 jan4
